gates.reason: The official SC2SLR code at the pinned commit cannot run as released, and it does not implement the paper's method. Faithful SC2SLR numbers would require inventing behavior-changing components that neither paper nor code specifies, and the result would then be conditional evidence. AGENTS.md requires a human decision before such a behavior-changing patch or reimplementation.
evidence: main.py:18 imports AlphaPose.get_image_keypoint and dataset/dataloader_video.py:23 imports AlphaPose.keypoint_to_heatmap.get_heatmap. AlphaPose/ is listed in .gitignore and absent from the commit. Neither module exists in upstream MVIG-SJTU/AlphaPose or anywhere GitHub code search reaches. Preference level 1 therefore fails at import.

There is no NT-Xent/contrastive loss, second view, projection head, or temperature anywhere in the code. slr_network.SLRModel.criterion_calculation implements only ConvCTC, SeqCTC, and Dist (SeqKD, T=8). The paper's Eq. 3/8 and Figure 2 require L_NT-Xent over two augmented views.

Paper-unspecified contrastive details: temperature tau, the representation contrasted (frame-level, sequence-pooled, or visual vs sequential features), projection head, whether the two encoders share weights, and the loss weight.

Keypoint fusion is under-specified. The paper (Eq. 2, Sec 3.2) adds a normalized 2n-dim coordinate vector point-wise to the RGB image, which is dimensionally undefined. The code instead adds a (T,224,224) heatmap from the missing get_heatmap to the normalized video. The heatmap rendering (sigma, keypoint subset of 90 from Halpe-136, normalization) is unknown.

Config conflicts with the paper: configs/baseline.yaml has num_epoch 80 (paper 120), batch_size 1 (paper 4), Dist weight 25.0 (Eq. 8 sums the terms unweighted), and RandomHorizontalFlip(0.5) in the training transform (paper Sec 4.3 excludes horizontal flip). TemporalRescale(0.2) is used where the paper says '0.5 random frame dropout'. Color jitter, grayscale, and blur appear only in an unused deep_transform().
The PHOENIX-2014T training recipe is not stated in the paper. configs/phoenix2014-T.yaml provides only paths.
dataloader_video.normalize calls torch.clamp(video, ...) without assigning the result, so the clamp has no effect. This is recorded as released behavior and is not proposed for change.

guesses_and_deviations.paper_or_evidence: Released loader calls get_heatmap(video, Keypoint_getter) on every augmented 224x224 frame; the modules are missing.
guesses_and_deviations.used: AlphaPose runs once on every original 210x260 frame; coordinates are scaled to 256x256 and carried through crop and temporal rescale as a heatmap channel.
guesses_and_deviations.rationale: Running the detector and pose model inside the loader for 120 epochs is about 10^8 extra passes. Geometrically the crop is applied identically.
guesses_and_deviations.effect: Keypoints come from uncropped frames, which can differ slightly from detection on crops.

guesses_and_deviations.used: configs/halpe_136/resnet/256x192_res50_lr1e-3_2x-regression.yaml with halpe136_fast50_regression_256x192.pth and YOLOv3-SPP; the highest-scoring person per frame.

guesses_and_deviations.paper_or_evidence: Paper Eq. 2 adds a normalized 2n-dim coordinate vector to the image (dimensionally undefined); released code adds a (T,224,224) heatmap from missing code.
guesses_and_deviations.used: Max over keypoints of confidence-weighted Gaussians, sigma 4 px at 256x256, values in [0,1], added to every RGB channel of the [-1,1] video, as the released normalize() does.
guesses_and_deviations.rationale: Follows the released fusion; sigma is invented.
guesses_and_deviations.effect: Behavior-changing; part of why results are conditional.

guesses_and_deviations.paper_or_evidence: Sec. 3.3, Eq. 3, Eq. 8, Fig. 2; no temperature, head, pooling, or weight sharing given. The released code has no contrastive loss.
guesses_and_deviations.used: Two views per clip from the released (unused) SimCLR deep_transform after one shared crop and temporal rescale; a weight-shared network on the 2B batch; all released losses on both views; NT-Xent with tau 0.5 and weight 1 on BiLSTM features mean-pooled over valid steps, no projection head.
guesses_and_deviations.rationale: The smallest addition that implements Eq. 3 and Eq. 8 with the code's existing augmentations.
guesses_and_deviations.effect: Behavior-changing; part of why results are conditional.

guesses_and_deviations.paper_or_evidence: Sec. 4.2, for PHOENIX-2014 only: 120 epochs, mini-batch 4, initial learning rate 1e-4 divided by 5 after epochs 40 and 60. guesses_and_deviations.rationale: Where the paper states a value for the Table 3 system, the paper wins.
guesses_and_deviations.effect: Follows the paper where stated; optimizer and weight decay from the released code.
